stories.title: He built his AI platform in 90 days. Now it makes $5M a year.
stories.caption: Rafael built his AI education platform in 90 days on Lovable. No VC, 100% inbound. Source: Lovable founder stories.

scenes.say: Rafael built his AI education platform in just ninety days, using Lovable.
scenes.label: 90 days

scenes.say: Last year it made around five million dollars. This year, they are aiming for twenty million.
scenes.label: $5M

scenes.say: No venture capital. Three people on product, and forty in sales.
scenes.label: $0 VC

scenes.say: They sell to two thousand companies in Brazil, and every single customer comes to them, from Instagram.
scenes.label: 2,000 companies

scenes.say: Customers even pay twelve months upfront. His biggest lesson? Distribution matters more than the product. Follow for one AI build story every day.
scenes.label: 12 months upfront

scenes.say: And founders are now building real companies on it. Follow for one AI build story every day.

stories.hook: A trainer built a 3.2M-a-year business with AI
stories.title: A corporate trainer used AI to build a business with 27,000 users
stories.caption: Alex turned company documents into 6 minute game-like lessons with Refine, built on Lovable. Source: Lovable founder stories.

scenes.say: Alex was a corporate trainer with a PhD in psycholinguistics.
scenes.label: PhD

scenes.say: He used Lovable to build Refine.
It turns boring company documents into six minute, game-like lessons, with simulations and AI voice feedback.
scenes.label: 6-minute lessons

scenes.say: Today it has twenty seven thousand users, and three point two million in contracted yearly revenue.
scenes.label: 27,000 users
